## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive; confirmation: weak sector breadth (3/11) and narrow leadership (Top 5: Tech 4/5) with major divergences among large caps, so reduce conviction. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (Tech 4/5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Note major divergence across blue-chips (MSFT, AMZN, MA, IBM) — MAJOR DIVERGENCE, treat momentum as tactical.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: Tech is up 1W but showing fractures between winners and key cap names; NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION — sector rotation within tech, watch follow-through.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak near-term: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — sector 1W negative and 1M negative, caution on broad exposure.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive names uneven: UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND — sector under pressure 1W and mixed 1M.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Energy and selective technology winners (MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to weak Materials and broad Financials; style mixed / no clear leadership. Given CAUTION and narrow leadership, emphasize tactical sizing and wait for breadth improvement.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +8.83%) for continued strength and corporate catalysts. BEARISH: Materials (1W: -6.92% | 1M: -5.40%), Consumer Staples (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -2.76%) showing downside pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch trend confirmation rather than price-only breaks: NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND needs sustained 1W strength to validate continuation; AAPL (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -6.80%) BELOW TREND must reclaim weekly momentum to signal stabilization; JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND needs a weekly reversal to remove banking downside risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (+75): INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND — news (Q2 beat, dividend hike, Anthropic deal) confirms price acceleration. PFE (+65): PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — bullish FDA/obesity item but short-term weakness; watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-60): BA (1W: +1.57% | 1M: -2.05%) RECOVERY — negative space/launch headlines conflict with short-term bounce, watch for operational updates. WMT (-55): WMT (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -3.28%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and FTC risk confirmed by price. MNST (-50): MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND — earnings-driven selloff confirmed.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; Style: mixed / no clear leadership. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among blue-chips (MSFT RECOVERY, AMZN RECOVERY, MA RECOVERY, IBM RECOVERY) and weak breadth (3/11) — monitor news-driven names for confirmation.
